cardano.label: Cardano
cardano.caption: A regular Cardano address.
cardano.description: A Cardano address starts with addr1 and isn't a script address.

cardanoScript.label: Cardano Script
cardanoScript.caption: A script address.
cardanoScript.description: A Cardano script address is for smart contracts and starts with addr1, followed by a specific pattern.

error.invalid: Not a valid Cardano script address.

plutus.headline: Smart contract address
plutus.caption:
The address you're sending to contains a plutus script, which usually requires additional data to be included in the transaction.
Proceeding to send might result in funds being lost.

unknown.headline: Unknown script address
unknown.caption:
Eternl could not identify the type of script at the address you're sending to.
Proceeding to send might result in those funds being lost.

adaHandle.label: ADA Handle
adaHandle.caption: A human-readable Cardano address.
adaHandle.description: An ADA Handle is a unique, NFT-based identifier you can use as a simplified Cardano address, starting with $.

change.title: ADA Handle address changed!
change.text:
Old address stored in address book:
####OLD####

New address:
####NEW####

The address represented by the ADA Handle ###HANDLE### changed since you added it to your address book.

If you send funds, they'll go to a different address than what's stored in your address book.
You can overwrite the current address book entry through the context menu.

address.invalid: Address invalid. (Maybe it's listed on a marketplace?)

unstoppableDomains.label: Unstoppable Domains
unstoppableDomains.caption: A blockchain domain name.
unstoppableDomains.description: Unstoppable Domains are decentralized domain names that can be linked to various cryptocurrency addresses, including Cardano.

address.invalid: Address invalid. (Maybe it's listed on a marketplace?)
address.notSet: This Unstoppable Domain has no Cardano address set.
